purpose: Complete v1 product acceptance, not a claim that the package already implements every item.

requirements.title: Native capability-aware capture
requirements.acceptance: Physical supported device completes native capture; unsupported hardware and camera denial are handled without pretending to scan.

requirements.title: One coordinated sensor session
requirements.acceptance: RoomPlan uses one coordinated AR session; no competing camera/session or mandatory GPS/audio/cloud pipeline.

requirements.title: Compatible-space multi-room capture
requirements.acceptance: Connected rooms merge in verified compatible coordinates; repeated rooms do not silently duplicate walls.

requirements.title: Truthful interruption recovery
requirements.acceptance: Retained rooms survive tested interruption; failed relocalization produces a separate reviewed segment, never guessed alignment.

requirements.title: Original source preservation
requirements.acceptance: Raw and processed Apple captures are retained before normalization with protected files and explicit source identity.

requirements.title: Quality guidance without fake scores
requirements.acceptance: Guidance reflects actual SDK/geometry evidence; classification confidence is not advertised positional accuracy.

requirements.title: Bounded device resources
requirements.acceptance: Low disk, thermal state, cancellation, duplicate finish and stale callback cases preserve honest state and bounded processing.

requirements.title: Explicit coordinate transforms
requirements.acceptance: Asymmetric rotated examples prove correct local-to-world and X/Z-to-screen conventions.

requirements.title: One canonical geometry source
requirements.acceptance: 2D/3D/exports derive from the same versioned walls, openings, nodes and rooms.

requirements.title: Topology and special geometry
requirements.acceptance: Shared nodes/walls, concave rooms, angled/curved paths, nonuniform surfaces and unresolved boundaries are represented or explicitly flagged without silent shape invention.

requirements.title: Opening host integrity
requirements.acceptance: Openings have validated host paths and bounds; ambiguous hosts, overlap and impossible geometry do not silently pass.

requirements.title: Stable IDs and lineage
requirements.acceptance: Rescans/edits preserve or explicitly map object IDs and source lineage; old report/annotation positions never silently move.

requirements.title: Measurement restraint
requirements.acceptance: No verified measurement/area/quantity claim; internal dimensions and assumed heights retain their source meaning.

requirements.title: Schema evolution
requirements.acceptance: Supported readers/writers reject or explicitly migrate unknown schemas; older golden documents remain recoverable.

requirements.title: Focused mobile workspace
requirements.acceptance: Capture, review, editing, export and recovery have task-specific layouts with stable project/floor context.

requirements.title: Direct editing
requirements.acceptance: Move/draw/split/join/delete walls, manipulate openings, label/manage rooms and distinguish semantic areas from physical walls.
requirements.owner_clarification: Reach at least companion in-scope manual drawing capability with clean UI, continuous/quick room creation, visible snaps, efficient selection and direct corrections. Same-task mouse/touch comparison required before parity/superiority claims. Business records/calibration/quantities stay excluded.

requirements.title: Undo and rejected-edit safety
requirements.acceptance: Commands support undo/redo, rejected edits roll back, and edit-after-publication preserves the issued source revision.

requirements.title: Review by consequence
requirements.acceptance: Actionable disconnected/boundary/opening issues jump to affected geometry; no fabricated automatic diagnosis.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.acceptance: Primary 44-point targets, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver object actions, noncolor statuses, Reduce Motion and no clipped critical controls.

requirements.title: Visual design fidelity
requirements.acceptance: White/light or deliberate dark canvas, semantic dark/colored edges, optional pale-blue fill; no checkerboard, photo texture, triangle noise or auto-spin.
requirements.owner_feedback: Owner likes the current mobile interactive 2D/3D visual direction; preserve it. Full manual usability/accessibility acceptance is still open.

requirements.title: Consistent selection and state
requirements.acceptance: 2D/3D switches retain selected object/floor and useful framing; dismissed panels preserve edits.

requirements.title: Actual architectural cutouts
requirements.acceptance: Doors/windows/openings cut wall faces; no painted rectangle that leaves a filled wall.

requirements.title: Interactive 3D
requirements.acceptance: Orbit, pan, zoom, reset and explicit cutaway/ceiling controls work smoothly from the same geometry.

requirements.title: Move-through navigation
requirements.acceptance: Room placement/tap-to-move works through accepted portals, not windows or unknown geometry; exit/reset always works.

requirements.title: Semantic line rendering
requirements.acceptance: No triangle diagonals or unwanted tessellation seams; optional translucent materials are configured/tested explicitly.

requirements.title: Resource lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Stable scene updates, cancelled stale work, bounded entities/buffers and verified release on repeated open/close.

requirements.title: Durable local drafts
requirements.acceptance: Acknowledged saves survive tested kill/relaunch and staged file/DB interruptions; in-memory state is not called saved.

requirements.title: Honest local/sync states
requirements.acceptance: Editing, saved locally, pending, receiver-confirmed and released are distinct states.

requirements.title: Immutable revisions
requirements.acceptance: Issued/publication artifacts are immutable and byte-identified; changes create new versions.

requirements.title: Protected private content
requirements.acceptance: File protection, retention, account/lock behavior and redacted diagnostics are verified before real-data deployment.

requirements.title: Offline behavior and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Editing/export of retained permitted work does not require connectivity; stale edits/revocation are reconciled explicitly.

requirements.title: Untrusted-file defenses
requirements.acceptance: Bounded archives/JSON/SVG reject traversal, symlinks, duplicates, nonfinite data, corrupt indices and active/external content.

requirements.title: Least privilege
requirements.acceptance: No client service key, credential URL, public raw bucket or cross-project/business grant from mere authentication.

requirements.title: Portable local exports
requirements.acceptance: Geometry plus polished 2D SVG/PDF/PNG and portable 3D export are generated from the exact selected revision.

requirements.title: Verified artifact identity
requirements.acceptance: Manifest lengths/hashes and document/floor/revision references are verified before trusted use.

requirements.title: Future integration without side effects
requirements.acceptance: Disabled adapter and tested proposed contract do not mutate OS/Moldo or create live infrastructure.

requirements.title: Publication correctness
requirements.acceptance: Authorized receiver implementation, when enabled, verifies stored bytes/current authority and prevents duplicates, stale replacement and forged success.

requirements.title: Moldo separation
requirements.acceptance: Selective reuse does not create OS membership or change Moldo engagement ownership; source audiences cannot widen.

requirements.title: Measured interaction budget
requirements.acceptance: Baseline-device p95 feedback, frame behavior and warm transitions are measured against declared workloads.

requirements.title: Different capture/render envelopes
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic stress proves engine behavior only; native capture claims use physical-scene evidence.

requirements.title: No unnecessary ongoing computation
requirements.acceptance: No cloud inference in ordinary editing, no unbounded frame queues or unnecessary background camera/render loops.

requirements.title: Actual Apple build and device evidence
requirements.acceptance: Real Xcode compile and target-device journeys are recorded separately from portable tests.

requirements.title: Complete v1 workflow
requirements.acceptance: Real capture -> correction -> 2D/3D navigation -> reopen -> export completes without fixture-only substitutions.

requirements.title: Truthful release and compatibility
requirements.acceptance: No readiness/superiority/background-worker claim beyond recorded evidence; source/rollback/signing/authorization gates are explicit.

requirements.title: One maintained full workspace
requirements.acceptance: The same maintained React/TypeScript editor provides full 2D/3D, revisions, save/reopen and required exports in standalone browser, AuxiliumOS and installed Capacitor app. A viewer or launcher is insufficient.
requirements.owner_clarification: Owner selected spatialauxilium.io and a dedicated Lovable project for independent delivery. Preserve OS Spatial selection UI only for now; later embed the same full workspace through its scoped adapter. Source transfer is not editor regeneration. Domain or sign-in does not establish sync/project authority.

requirements.title: Authorized OS project context
requirements.acceptance: The OS embeds the complete workspace only after current authenticated project access checks; namespaces isolate profile/account/project and revoked contexts clear visible data.

requirements.title: Browser behavior and truthful persistence
requirements.acceptance: Fresh TypeScript and real browser tests verify edits, undo/redo, reopened saves, revision conflicts, imports, exact exports and collision/cutaway. Swift evidence is not reused as TypeScript acceptance.

requirements.title: Versioned installed native bridge
requirements.acceptance: The installed Capacitor app contains shared workspace assets and invokes actual retained Swift capture through bridge 1.0.0. Browser capture fails closed, sources remain protected and native/web revision conflicts cannot overwrite work.

architecture_correction: 2026-10-09 owner-approved shared React/TypeScript workspace with Capacitor native Apple capture. Original acceptance retained.
